answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops bulk fake identities. Each agent escrows a 10-unit deposit per job slot at the wharf, where identities dock for inspection. Work passes through a narrow inlet, one slot at a time, checked by five rotating peers. Fake work burns the deposit; the verdict is carved on a marble ledger. Forging 100 identities costs 1,000 units, all burned, and earns nothing. Honest agents pay once per slot and recover the deposit.
